## Purpose

`rebar metrics`'s structural metrics need three analyzers: **lizard** (Python, complexity),
**scc** (Go, size) and **jscpd** (Node, duplication). They have reported `unavailable` in this
repository since they shipped, so rebar has never dogfooded its own code-health metrics.

Operator request 2026-08-05: install them on this machine AND make new venvs in this project
get them.

## Corrected premise -- VERIFIED against the tree, replacing the original assumption

The ticket was written assuming *no bootstrap path installs lizard*. **That is false**, and the
correction reshapes the whole ticket:

- `pyproject.toml` `dev` extra self-references `nava-rebar[agents,metrics]`, and
  `metrics = ["lizard>=1.23"]`. So `uv sync --locked --extra dev` and `pip install -e '.[dev]'`
  **already** pull lizard transitively.
- Proven empirically: a worktree provisioned by `make worktree` on **unmodified `main`** imports
  `lizard` 1.23.0 successfully. AC "a fresh venv can import lizard" **already passes on `main`**.
- `uv.lock` already pins lizard 1.23.0 (`uv.lock`, `name = "lizard"` / `1.23.0`), reached via the
  `metrics` extra marker. So no lock update is needed and `uv lock --check` cannot drift.

The lizard half of this ticket is therefore **not a fix but a hardening**: the `dev` extra pulls
metrics *incidentally*, and its own comment says it is there so optional-capability tests RUN in
CI. That is a CI-testing rationale, not a "dev envs get the analyzers" rationale -- so if that
self-reference is ever trimmed, local venvs would silently lose lizard and `rebar metrics` would
regress to `unavailable` with nothing to catch it. Naming the extra explicitly in the two
bootstrap paths pins the intent independently of the CI rationale.

## What this ticket changes

1. `Makefile` `install`: `uv sync --locked --extra dev` -> `uv sync --locked --extra dev --extra
   metrics`. Behaviour-preserving today (metrics already arrives via `dev`); the value is that
   the dev bootstrap now states the dependency itself. Extend the existing uv-locked comment
   (ticket ce5d) with this rationale -- do not overwrite it.
2. `Makefile` `install-unlocked`: `pip install -e '.[dev]'` -> `'.[dev,metrics]'`, same rationale.
   `make worktree` delegates to `make install`, so worktree venvs are covered by change 1 with no
   separate edit -- confirm by reading the target, do not duplicate the change.
3. Document the two NON-Python analyzers in `docs/local-dev-env.md`. They cannot come from a
   Python extra, so a documented install step is the only route. Use exactly the commands proven
   on this machine: `brew install scc` (Go) and `npm install -g jscpd` (Node). State plainly that
   they are **optional** and that their absence degrades to a clean `Unavailable` in
   `rebar metrics`, never a hard failure.

## End state / scope boundary

Post-change, a dev venv can run the **lizard-backed complexity** and **jscpd-backed duplication**
metrics. The **scc-backed size metrics still return a confident zero** -- blocked on sibling bug
`c5b3-1b8a-08dd-40af` (the adapter omits `--by-file`). This ticket does not claim to make
`rebar metrics` complete; it makes the toolchain installable and documented.

## CI impact -- checked

CI does **not** call `make install`. Every workflow invokes `uv sync --locked --extra ...` (or
`pip install -e .`) directly, so no `Makefile` edit here can reach CI. CI also already receives
lizard transitively via `dev`. CI is unaffected; no workflow change is needed.

## Explicitly NOT in scope

- Adding a `[code_health]` section to `rebar.toml` (scan_roots / size_cap). That is real
  dogfooding config and must follow the scc bug being fixed, otherwise it would enshrine the
  broken zero.
- `code_health.enabled` is INERT (bug a573-00ea-2bf6-4eb1) -- do not set it expecting an effect.
- Installing scc/jscpd automatically, or gating any target on their presence.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `Makefile` `install` names `--extra metrics` and `install-unlocked` names `.[dev,metrics]`,
      with the existing uv-locked rationale comment preserved and extended, not replaced.
- [x] `make worktree` is confirmed by inspection to delegate to `make install` (no second edit).
- [x] A venv provisioned by the edited `make install` imports `lizard` 1.23.0.
- [x] `uv lock --check` passes on the change (no lock drift), proving the metrics extra was
      already locked.
- [x] `docs/local-dev-env.md` documents `brew install scc` and `npm install -g jscpd`, marks both
      optional, and states that absence degrades to `Unavailable` rather than failing.
- [x] PROVEN, not asserted: with `scc` and `jscpd` made unresolvable on `PATH`, `make install`,
      `make lint`, `make typecheck` and the test suite all still succeed, and `rebar metrics`
      reports `unavailable` for the affected lenses instead of erroring. Evidence recorded as a
      ticket comment.
- [x] CI is unaffected -- confirmed by showing no workflow invokes `make install`.
